opening: My Sister’s Suicide Note. As soon as I got home, I wrote a suicide note for my dead younger sister. It was easy: I only had to describe my own wish to die.
reference_answer: We are identical twins. Our mother favors my sister and abuses me. My sister breaks our mother’s belongings and plants my book to blame me. Fearing a fatal beating, I trick her into swapping clothes, claiming I will take her punishment. She goes home first, dressed as me. When I arrive outside, I see her fall from above, dead. I forge her suicide note using my own despair.
